rows.en:
(Going out alone felt lonely, so I invited her,
but she seemed a little hesitant.
Maybe I was bothering her...)

\p-kun,
I'm sorry, I'm late again...

No, it's not even time to meet yet,
so it's fine.

Oh, really? I always get here after you,
\p-kun, so I just assumed I was late.
Haha, you're such a scatterbrain.

Hee hee, I guess so.
So, where were we planning to go today?
Mainly I want to do some shopping, but...
Okay, then let's get going.

Man, I'm glad I invited you, Akimizu.
You've got great taste,
and shopping was fun too.

Huh? Oh, not at all.
Claire-senpai's always telling me, "Yuu,
you need to polish yourself more as a woman!"
Really? Claire-senpai's tough...

But Senpai's really amazing, so no matter
what she says, I end up agreeing...
Yes, that's right.
rows.notes: x4: Akimizu here; also the player answering Klan in nml_kln_010 ('Off to PE?').

rows.en:
I see...
Anyway, what should we do next?

Oh, I think I'm getting a little hungry...
Want to stop by Nyan-Nyan?
Looks like they're running some campaign now.

Sounds good. To thank you,
I'll treat you today.
Hmm~ Then I guess I'll take you up on that!

"Nyan-Nyan-Nyan Half-Price Campaign!"...
Nyan-Nyan-Nyan...?! Feels like one too many...
rows.notes: Male. Pun: the campaign name writes the Nyan-Nyan character three times; the extra one reads 'girl' (explained in c15255). Rendered Nyan-Nyan-Nyan.

rows.en:
Wooow, half price!
We've just gotta go in!
Ah, wait...
Welcome to Nyan-Nyan~!

We're running a campaign right now,
and everyone who takes part gets
everything on the menu at half price~
Oh, yes, yes! Count me in!
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu; quoted back in c15256.

rows.en:
Thank you very much! Miss, this way, please.
And sir, let me show you to your table~
(Huh?! What on earth is going on...)
Um, sorry to keep you waiting...
rows.notes: x2, Akimizu, now in a Nyan-Nyan uniform.

rows.en: Huh?! Akimizu, what happened to you?

Apparently the "Nyan-Nyan-Nyan Campaign" means
you get half price if the girl of a couple
changes into a Nyan-Nyan uniform...

...Oh, I get it... A girl in a Nyan-Nyan outfit...
...So that's why it's "Nyan-Nyan-Nyan"...
rows.notes: Male; pun explanation (Nyan-Nyan + girl); the wordplay does not survive in English.

rows.en:
Ugh, I shouldn't have gotten carried away
and said "Count me in!"...

Well, if it gets us half price,
that's a small price to pay!
Geez! Easy for you to say!
Now, now...
And calling us a "couple" of all things...
Huh, so people see us that way too?
Huh? Th-that's...
Well, let's call it a day.

(Things got a little awkward, but...
I got to see Akimizu in a Nyan-Nyan uniform...
Maybe I got lucky.)

(Going out alone felt lonely, so I invited her,
but she seemed a little hesitant.
Maybe I was bothering her...)

\p-chan,
I'm sorry, I'm late again...

No, it's not even time to meet yet,
so it's fine.

Oh, really? I always get here after you,
\p-chan, so I just assumed I was late.
Haha, you're such a scatterbrain.

Man, I'm glad I invited you, Yuu.
You've got great taste,
and shopping was fun too.
Really? Claire-senpai's tough...
Is that how it works...?
rows.notes: Female; as c09279, the male twin.

rows.en:
I see...
Anyway, what should we do next?

Sounds good. To thank you,
I'll treat you today.

"Nyan-Nyan-Nyan Half-Price Campaign!"...
Nyan-Nyan-Nyan...?! Isn't that one too many...?

Thank you very much!
The two of you, this way please~

(Huh?! Why are they taking us
to the changing room...?)

Apparently the "Nyan-Nyan-Nyan Campaign" means
you get half price if the female customers
change into Nyan-Nyan uniforms...
rows.notes: Akimizu, female scene; both girls are in uniform.

rows.en: I can't believe I ended up in this too...

Well, if it gets us half price,
that's a small price to pay!
Yeah... well... I guess you're right!

(Nyan-Nyan-Nyan was a bit of a shock,
but it was fun.)
(Right, I'm supposed to go out with Akimizu today...)

\p-kun, I'm sorry.
I'm late again...

No, I haven't been waiting that long,
so it's fine.
Phew, good. Then let's get going!
Whew, I'm tired. And hungry too.
Yeah, I can't wait for the food to come~

Oh, by the way, what about the
"Nyan-Nyan-Nyan Campaign" today...?
I'm. Not. Doing. It!
Yeah, figured~...
Honestly, geez!
(Guess she's not doing that again...)
(Right, I'm supposed to go out with Yuu today...)

\p-chan, I'm sorry.
I'm late again...
No, I haven't been waiting long. It's fine.
Whew, I'm tired. And hungry too.
Y-yeah, of course not~...
rows.notes: Female; relieved, since she would have to dress up too.

rows.en: (Come to think of it, it wasn't just her problem...)
rows.notes: Female (hitogoto ja nakatta): the campaign would have put her in a uniform too.

uncertain: c15244/c15255/c15275: the campaign pun (the Nyan-Nyan character written three times, the extra one read as 'girl') kept as 'Nyan-Nyan-Nyan'; c15255 explains it as 'a girl in a Nyan-Nyan outfit', but the wordplay itself is lost.
